attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Mental Health Counselors and Marriage and Family Therapists (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs sponsored or approved by ACA, AMHCA, NBCC, AAMFT, RIMHCA, RICA, RIAMFT, NASW, APA, AMA or other Board-approved national organizations. Category I (formal courses, workshops, institutes incl. web-based, 1 credit/hour): min 20 credits. Category II: publications/formal lectures (10 credits each), national/international elected office (20).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by examination after the July 1 renewal date: exempt until the next renewal cycle (June 30 of the next even year).
rules.audit_note: Licensee must keep sponsor documentation (date, time, subject, lecturer, hours).
rules.notes: Renewal per R.I. Gen. Laws §5-63.2-17; 40 credits over the two years before re-licensure. No specific mandatory topics stated in the rule.
